items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: I do remember Louis Armstrong being at the suburban, suburban, suburban gardens. And he'd broadcast from there and then the late broadcast every night.

ctx.x: I was wondering, people like Kid Rene.

No. I sure didn't. The only thing I can remember, to be truthful, because at those times people threw little parties. They had little house parties and they would hire a three or four piece band and roll back the rug in the living room, you see, and take the sofa out in the neighborhoods and they would hire a little three or four piece band and they would be dancing and near beer or a beer or a beer. Or a homebrew. But I do remember Louis Armstrong being at the suburban, suburban, suburban gardens. And he'd…
I wonder when that was, I wonder if that was the time of your time here. 31.
